donatePage.intro: If Nostr.how has been useful, these are the simplest ways to help keep the site improving.
donatePage.zapBody: If you already use Nostr, the easiest way to support Nostr.how is to zap JeffG directly from your favorite client.
donatePage.lightningBody: If you prefer a straight Lightning payment, you can send sats directly to the Nostr.how Lightning address below.
donatePage.supportBody: If you want to help fund a larger content, translation, or design push, reach out to JeffG on Nostr and we can coordinate.
